title: Transitional provision.
bodyText: This chapter applies to arbitration of a family law dispute under an arbitration agreement made on or after July 10, 2017. If an arbitration agreement was made before July 10, 2017, the parties may agree in a record that this chapter applies to the arbitration.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: "July 10, 2017" substituted for "the effective date of this chapter" pursuant to §23G-15.

bodyHtml:
[§658J-27]  Transitional provision.  This chapter applies to arbitration of a family law dispute under an arbitration agreement made on or after July 10, 2017.  If an arbitration agreement was made before July 10, 2017, the parties may agree in a record that this chapter applies to the arbitration. [L 2017, c 113, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  "July 10, 2017" substituted for "the effective date of this chapter" pursuant to §23G-15.
